result.analyst_notes: Aspirational, value-led page using first-person plural throughout and short declarative slogans for core values. Customers and people are placed first, with inclusion and integrity given headline status. Commitments are stated absolutely ('We do the right thing'), while the workforce section uses 'will' and 'committed'. Environment, shareholders and innovation are absent.
